# LAST SEEN [italic]For the families. Names, faces, the last shift. Somebody out there saw them after we did.[/italic]
There is a board on the deep wire that tracks whole stations going quiet, and it does that well. This one is smaller. It is for one person at a time: a son who did not come up from second shift, a wife who went to the clinic with a cough, a brother who was walked to the garrison gym and not walked back. We post them here because the colony net takes our notices down in a day and the administration says they have no record of the request.
[color=#8C3B2E][bold]IF YOU RECOGNISE SOMEONE, POST IN THEIR THREAD. YOU DO NOT NEED A NAME. A TIME AND A PLACE IS ENOUGH.[/bold][/color]
## HOW WE DO THINGS HERE - First name and an initial. Age, job, colony, the date and place they were last seen, and what they were wearing. A detail only family would notice helps more than a photo. - One thread per person, posted by family or by someone the family asked. - Do not tell a family their person is dead. Not even if you think you know. Tell the mods, and we will decide with the family how to say it. - Do not post here to sell anything. People who say they can find someone for a fee are not finding anyone. - When someone comes home, the title gets FOUND in front of it. Found threads are never taken down. We need to see them.

## IF YOU ARE READING THIS ON {colony} Look at the faces at your next shift change. Then look at the roster. If they do not match, write down who is missing and when you last saw them, today, before someone tells you they were transferred.
